onepager.title: AI 보조기구 확산과 온디바이스 AI 성능 향상
onepager.sourceLine: 최근 여러 기업들이 AI 보조기구를 확장하며 시장 점유율을 높이고자 하는 전략을 세우고 있음.
onepager.scope: 스마트폰, 태블릿, 웨어러블 기기, 서비스 수익화
onepager.thesis: AI 보조기구의 성장은 온디바이스 AI 성능 향상과 함께 경쟁력 강화의 기회를 제공한다.

insights.title: AI 보조기구의 사용자 접근성 증가
insights.body: AI 보조기구의 제공 범위가 확대됨에 따라 사용자 수가 증가할 것으로 예상된다. 이는 서비스 성과 개선으로 이어져 경쟁력을 강화할 가능성이 있다.

insights.title: 효율적인 온디바이스 AI 성능 향상
insights.body: AI 보조기구로 인해 온디바이스 AI의 성능이 향상될 수 있다. 이는 사용자 경험 개선과 연계되어 시장 점유율 확대에 기여할 것이다.

insights.title: AI 기술의 경제적 가치 증대
insights.body: AI 조기 도입으로 인해 기업의 운영 효율성이 개선되고 있으며, 이는 서비스 수익화와 직결된다. AI 투자에 대한 긍정적인 결과가 기대된다.

insights.title: 경쟁사 대응 전략 필요성
insights.body: AI 보조기구에 대한 대응 전략이 필요하다. 경쟁사와의 차별화를 통해 시장에서의 위치를 더욱 강화할 수 있다.

metrics.t: AI 모델 및 플랫폼 시장 규모 예상
AI 플랫폼 및 모델 시장 성장률
CFO들이 AI 투자의 생산성 향상 경향

implications.text: 온디바이스 AI와 연결된 서비스 모델 개발이 필요하다.
AI 효율성을 높이기 위한 부품 조달 전략 강화가 필수적이다.
패러다임 변화에 맞춘 경쟁 전략 수립이 필요하다.
AI 기술을 접목한 혁신적인 제품 개발이 중요하다.

onepager.conclusion: AI 보조기구의 확산은 단말 사업의 성과에 긍정적인 영향을 미칠 것으로 예상된다. 온디바이스 AI의 성능 향상은 경쟁력을 높이는 핵심 요소가 될 것이다.
onepager.watch: AI 관련 규제가 기업의 혁신과 경제성에 미치는 영향을 면밀히 검토해야 한다.

feed.title: AI Is Short of Capacity, Not Demand
feed.desc: AI Is Short of Capacity, Not Demand    IDC | Trusted Tech Intelligence
feed.titleEn: AI Is Short of Capacity, Not Demand
feed.descEn: Worried about an AI correction? Power, memory, and packaging shortages, not demand, will limit AI growth through 2027. See IDC’s data.
summaryLinesEn: IDC tracks markets, not balance sheets, so we start with the demand side, and it is strong. 95% of enterprises already run AI agents in production with inferencing-specific actions, and IDC expects 2.5 billion agents by 2030.
We expect easily adoptable open-weight models to shift inference to private, sovereign, and edge environments, diverting some inference demand away from public cloud providers.
In the past 12 months, 31% of companies have shifted at least some workloads from proprietary to open-weight models, according to the IDC AI Economics and Cost Management Survey.

localization.title: AI는 수요가 아니라 용량이 부족하
summaryLines: IDC는 대차대조표가 아닌 시장을 추적하므로 수요 측면부터 시작하는데 이는 강력함 · 95%의 기업이 이미 추론 관련 작업을 통해 프로덕션 환경에서 AI 에이전트를 실행하고 있으며, IDC는 2030년까지 에이전트가 25억 개에 달할 것으로 예상함
쉽게 채택할 수 있는 개방형 가중치 모델이 추론을 프라이빗, 주권 및 엣지 환경으로 전환하여 일부 추론 수요를 퍼블릭 클라우드 제공업체로부터 전환시킬 것으로 기대함
IDC AI 경제 및 비용 관리 설문조사에 따르면 지난 12개월 동안 기업의 31%가 최소한 일부 워크로드를 독점 모델에서 개방형 모델로 전환함

feed.title: Los países de América Latina más preparados para la inteligencia artificial, según ranking de Cepal
feed.desc: Los países de América Latina más preparados para la inteligencia artificial, según ranking de Cepal    Bloomberg Línea
feed.titleEn: Los países de América Latina más preparados para la inteligencia artificial, según ranking de Cepal
feed.descEn: El Índice Latinoamericano de Inteligencia Artificial (ILIA), de la Cepal, evalúa los ecosistemas de IA de los países a partir de tres dimensiones: los factores habilitantes; la investigación, desarrollo y adopción y la gobernanza.
summaryLinesEn: La adopción de inteligencia artificial es del 27,6% en las grandes empresas, frente al 12,8% de las medianas y el 6,8% de las pequeñas.
El país con la mayor puntuación del Índice Latinoamericano de Inteligencia Artificial (ILIA) fue Chile, con 71,4 sobre 100, seguido por Brasil (68,4) y Uruguay (67), según el reporte.

(Bloomberg Creative/Bloomberg Creative Photos) Bloomberg Línea — Chile, Brasil y Uruguay son los países más desarrollados en la adopción de la inteligencia artificial en 2026 en la región, según un nuevo informe publicado por la Comisión Económica para América Latina y el Caribe (Cepal) y el Centro Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial de Chile (Cenia).

쉽게 채택할 수 있는 개방형 가중치 모델이 추론을 프라이빗, 주권 및 엣지 환경으로 전환하여 일부 추론 수요를 퍼블릭 클라우드 제공업체로부터 전환시킬 것으로 기대함
IDC AI 경제 및 비용 관리 설문조사에 따르면 지난 12개월 동안 기업의 31%가 최소한 일부 워크로드를 독점 모델에서 개방형 모델로 전환함
feed.titleEn: AI Is Short of Capacity, Not Demand
feed.descEn: Worried about an AI correction? Power, memory, and packaging shortages, not demand, will limit AI growth through 2027. See IDC’s data.
summaryLinesEn: IDC tracks markets, not balance sheets, so we start with the demand side, and it is strong. 95% of enterprises already run AI agents in production with inferencing-specific actions, and IDC expects 2.5 billion agents by 2030.
We expect easily adoptable open-weight models to shift inference to private, sovereign, and edge environments, diverting some inference demand away from public cloud providers.
In the past 12 months, 31% of companies have shifted at least some workloads from proprietary to open-weight models, according to the IDC AI Economics and Cost Management Survey.

summaryLines: Motley Fool • 2개월 전 NVDA MSFT AI가 소프트웨어 구축 비용을 낮추고 데이터 및 배포가 해자가 됨 Motley Fool • 10일 전 ANTH.PVT NVDA Morningstar는 소프트웨어 주식이 지난 3년 동안 이렇게 저평가된 적이 없었다고 말함

sourceContent.headline: Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley are dominating the AI stock boom. Here's their edge
sourceContent.description: Wall Street’s Big Three have generated $52 billion in equity trading revenue this year, capturing about 80% of the market on rising margin lending to hedge funds.
paragraphs: Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan captured nearly 80% of top five bank equity trading revenues so far this year, generating a combined $52 billion.

While the CEOs of Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley have said the AI build-out is still in its early years, if AI turns out to be not as transformative as hoped, a downturn could impact those banks more than others, analysts said.
At Goldman Sachs, equities financing activities jumped 96% in the third quarter to a record $3.37 billion.

feed.title: From Connectivity to Capability: How UNU-MERIT and ITU Are Strengthening Digital Policy
feed.desc: From Connectivity to Capability: How UNU-MERIT and ITU Are Strengthening Digital Policy    UNU | United Nations University
feed.titleEn: From Connectivity to Capability: How UNU-MERIT and ITU Are Strengthening Digital Policy
feed.descEn: The third piece in our UN Day series looks at how UNU-MERIT and ITU work together to make digital development more inclusive.
summaryLinesEn: UNU-MERIT contributes a different set of strengths: research on technological transformation through the lenses of innovation, governance and development, alongside experience in translating academic knowledge into professional education and capacity development.
The importance of the UNU-MERIT–ITU partnership therefore extends beyond individual courses or research projects.

ITU contributes global policy relationships and an extensive evidence base on connectivity and digitalisation; UNU-MERIT contributes research on technological, social and institutional change together with the pedagogical expertise needed to turn that research into professional learning.

sourceContent.description: Rising memory prices and tightening supply are reportedly pushing some Chinese smartphone makers to turn to salvaged chips. According to TechNews, som...
paragraphs: Rising memory prices and tightening supply are reportedly pushing some Chinese smartphone makers to turn to salvaged chips.

According to TechNews , some brands are said to be sourcing memory chips recovered from discarded phones through traders in Shenzhen’s Huaqiangbei electronics market, potentially including chips from used iPhones.

Although the forecast was revised upward due to earlier-than-expected purchases and brands restoring some production, TrendForce cautioned that rising memory costs could put further pressure on the market in 2027.

summaryLinesEn: By Morgan Stanley’s count, 91.7% of Nvidia’s 2027 revenue is exposed to one thing: AI infrastructure demand.
Morgan Stanley’s own power model projects a 32-gigawatt U.S. shortfall for data centers through 2028, about one-third of the 97 gigawatts needed.
About $1 trillion of the 2027 spending lands as S&P 500 revenue, by Morgan Stanley’s estimate.

feed.titleEn: Stock Market Today, Oct. 19: Amazon Surges on Morgan Stanley Top Pick and $350 Price Target | The Motley Fool
feed.descEn: Today, Oct. 19, 2026, Morgan Stanley's upgrade reinforced Amazon Web Services and AI momentum ahead of October 29 earnings.
summaryLinesEn: 19, Morgan Stanley named Amazon a top pick, kept an Overweight rating, and lifted its target to $350 from $335.

Wall Street investors will be expecting another quarter of strong performance when Amazon reports Q3 2026 earnings on October 29, although litigation and regulatory risk remain a longer-term overhang on valuation.
Morgan Stanley noted five key catalysts for Amazon's stock, including AWS growth nearly tripling from 2025 to 2028 as customers increasingly adopt AI.

feed.desc: Gartner analyst behind tech rout: AI returns are not yet large enough to justify neocloud build-out    CNBC
feed.titleEn: Gartner analyst behind tech rout: AI returns are not yet large enough to justify neocloud build-out
feed.descEn: The firm stands behind analysis that sent shockwaves through the market last week.
summaryLinesEn: "By the end of [Wednesday], the market appeared to already be on edge when a report from Gartner dropped, warning that more than $3.5tn in AI infrastructure spending could be exposed to impairment by 2030, with neocloud providers particularly vulnerable," Stephanie Wolfe at Roth wrote to clients.
Wall Street research and advisory firm Gartner is standing by its forecast that $3.5 trillion in AI investment could be on the rocks due to profitability concerns among the top AI models.
In their Wednesday report, Gartner researchers found that overall "AI revenue will be insufficient to support profitable returns on all planned AI capital expenditures" between 2027 and 2030.

summaryLines: Roth의 Stephanie Wolfe는 고객에게 "수요일 말까지 2030년까지 3조 5천억 달러 이상의 AI 인프라 지출이 손상될 수 있으며 네오클라우드 제공업체가 특히 취약할 수 있다는 Gartner의 보고서가 발표되었을 때 시장은 이미 불안한 것처럼 보였음" · 라고 썼음
월스트리트 연구 및 자문 회사인 Gartner는 최고 AI 모델의 수익성 문제로 인해 3조 5천억 달러 규모의 AI 투자가 위태로워질 수 있다는 예측을 고수하고 있음
Gartner 연구원들은 수요일 보고서에서 2027년에서 2030년 사이에 "AI 수익이 계획된 모든 AI 자본 지출에 대한 수익성 있는 수익을 지원하기에는 충분하지 않을 것"이라는 사실을 발견함

feed.titleEn: Bank of America Warns AI Investment Cycle Could Face Pressure From Competition and Falling Prices
feed.descEn: Bank of America has identified similarities between the current artificial intelligence investment cycle and previous periods of large-scale capital spending, citing rising investment expectations, increased competition and declining prices for AI services. summaryLinesEn: According to Bank of America, consensus expectations for hyperscaler capital expenditure over the next 12 months have increased from $330 billion in early 2025 to approximately $1 trillion.

Bank of America identified increasing competition in the AI model market as a potential factor affecting the financial returns generated by infrastructure investment.

sourceContent.headline: Costa Rica y Guatemala como modelos regionales: la estrategia que la CEPAL propone para transformar el comercio exterior centroamericano
sourceContent.description: Servicios tecnológicos, ciberseguridad e inteligencia artificial encabezan la hoja de ruta del organismo de la ONU para diversificar las ventas externas de la subregión y reducir la dependencia estructural de los mercados tradicionales
paragraphs: Costa Rica apenas avanzaría 1% en términos de intercambio y Guatemala rondaría 2%.
La paralización dejó sin empleo a más de 6,000 trabajadores directos y 30.000 indirectos, un golpe que todavía se refleja en las estadísticas de comercio exterior que releva la CEPAL.
El Salvador , Costa Rica y Guatemala quedaron por debajo del promedio regional en crecimiento exportador del primer semestre, con subas de entre 4% y 6%.

feed.desc: Accenture's Revenue Targets Ease AI Fears, Support Growth Outlook, UBS Says    Yahoo Finance
feed.titleEn: Accenture's Revenue Targets Ease AI Fears, Support Growth Outlook, UBS Says
feed.descEn: Accenture's (ACN) new 2027-2029 targets should ease fears that AI will disintermediate the company,
summaryLinesEn: The brokerage said in a Wednesday note the company's outlook for at least mid-single-digit constant-currency revenue growth in fiscal 2027-28, followed by mid-to-high single-digit growth in fiscal 2029, was well above Street expectations of continued mid-single-digit growth.

Accenture's (ACN) new 2027-2029 targets should ease fears that AI will disintermediate the company, as UBS Securities sees parallels with past technology shifts such as offshoring and cloud that ultimately accelerated revenue growth.
UBS said the targets support its view that generative AI can add roughly 350-400 basis points to revenue growth.

feed.title: AI-First Enterprises: Trends and Emerging Directions
feed.desc: AI-First Enterprises: Trends and Emerging Directions    Nasscom
feed.titleEn: AI-First Enterprises: Trends and Emerging Directions
feed.descEn: Key Highlights AI spend is trending upward, decoupling from technology budget growth, as enterprises shift from AI preparedness to deployment at scale. AI spending is entering a scale-up phase despite geopolitical and macroeconomic uncertainty. Spanning cloud and data foundations, AI technologies and talent, and human-AI operating models, AI allocation for CY26 has nearly doubled from CY25.
summaryLinesEn: It is reinforced by aggressive investment plans as 2-in-3 AI-first enterprises are increasing the AI spend growth rate in CY26 over and above that in CY25.

AI-first execution is shifting decisively from experimentation to industrialization. 3-in 4 AI-first enterprises have scaled-up PoCs as they work towards industrializing AI with better AI technology selection, architectural integration, builder and enablement talent, and the focus on scaling intelligence over use cases.
AI-first strategy is shifting from cost optimization to customer-centric growth.
feed.summary:

feed.desc: Gartner forecasts massive AI infrastructure write-downs    TechTarget
feed.titleEn: Gartner forecasts massive AI infrastructure write-downs | TechTarget
feed.descEn: Gartner forecasts that up to 80% of neoclouds will cease independent operations by 2030, as projected AI infrastructure costs exceed projected revenue.
summaryLinesEn: Published this week, Gartner's new forecast estimated that some $3.5 trillion in AI infrastructure investments will ultimately be written off, triggering extreme market consolidation by 2030.

This is because AI providers are expected to spend up to $7 trillion on infrastructure by 2030, which would require $8.5 trillion in revenues to cover announced capital spending, financing costs and a 12% return on invested capital.
Gartner forecasts that up to 80% of neoclouds will cease independent operations by 2030, as projected AI infrastructure costs exceed projected revenue.

feed.title: Amid AI boom, Morgan Stanley leans into role of its people
feed.desc: Amid AI boom, Morgan Stanley leans into role of its people    Yahoo Finance
feed.titleEn: Amid AI boom, Morgan Stanley leans into role of its people
feed.descEn: The investment banking giant, which has opened its doors to AI tools and capabilities, is still committed to being clients' trusted advisor, CEO Ted Pick said Wednesday.
summaryLinesEn: Talk of AI followed a strong quarter for Morgan Stanley, which reported net revenues of $20.3 billion for the period ending Sept. 30, up from $18.2 billion in the year-ago quarter.

Non-compensation-related expenses were $5.7 billion, rising 20% from the year-ago quarter due to double-digit increases in areas such as brokerage, clearing and exchange fees as well as marketing and business development costs.
Wealth management, one of Morgan Stanley's three core businesses, had record quarterly revenues of $9.1 billion.

feed.title: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents like Muse, Instinct from directly accessing accounts
feed.desc: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents like Muse, Instinct from directly accessing accounts    CNBC
feed.titleEn: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents like Muse, Instinct from directly accessing accounts
feed.descEn: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon warned of rogue agents operating at scale and said the bank is building defensive tools.
summaryLinesEn: The startup behind the service, San Francisco-based Spear Street Technology, was founded last year and reached a $10 billion valuation last month.
JPMorgan moved to charge data middlemen including Plaid for access, a dispute that similarly pitted the bank's security concerns against tech firms' demands for access.
That means that AI agents can access some customer data from Chase accounts in a read-only fashion, such as customer balances, if Plaid or another connector has the user's credentials.

summaryLinesEn: By Che Pan and Farah Master Beijing, Oct 13 (Reuters) - China's third-quarter smartphone shipments fell 15.4% from a year earlier to 57.9 million units, research firm IDC said on Tuesday.

feed.desc: Investors Matter for the Future of Trustworthy AI. Are they ready?    OECD AI Policy Observatory

sourceContent.headline: Investors Matter for the Future of Trustworthy AI. Are they ready?
sourceContent.description: Investors are beginning to treat trustworthy AI not as a niche governance issue but as a material business factor.
paragraphs: Investors see AI trustworthiness as financially material At the GPAI Expert Group on Trustworthy AI Investment meeting, held on 11 June 2026, one message emerged clearly from discussions across public and private markets: investors no longer view trustworthy AI as a purely ethical consideration.

The GPAI Expert Group on Trustworthy AI Investment wants to help bridge this gap by examining how investors can help advance trustworthy AI by integrating governance, accountability and risk management considerations into investment decisions.

But when investment committees sit down to make decisions, they often lack the common language, data, tools, experience, and signals needed to translate trustworthiness, as reflected in the OECD AI Principles, into something they can evaluate and act on.

summaryLines: 투자자들은 AI 신뢰성을 재정적으로 중요한 요소로 보고 있음 · 2026년 6월 11일에 개최된 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 투자에 관한 GPAI 전문가 그룹 회의에서 공공 및 민간 시장 전반의 논의에서 한 가지 메시지가 분명하게 나타남 · 즉, 투자자들은 더 이상 신뢰할 수 있는 AI를 순전히 윤리적인 고려 사항으로 보지 않는다는 것임
신뢰할 수 있는 AI 투자에 관한 GPAI 전문가 그룹은 투자자가 거버넌스, 책임 및 위험 관리 고려 사항을 투자 결정에 통합하여 신뢰할 수 있는 AI를 발전시키는 데 어떻게 도움을 줄 수 있는지 검토함으로써 이러한 격차를 해소하는 데 도움을 주고자 함
그러나 투자위원회가 결정을 내릴 때 OECD AI 원칙에 반영된 신뢰성을 평가하고 조치할 수 있는 것으로 변환하는 데 필요한 공통 언어, 데이터, 도구, 경험 및 신호가 부족한 경우가 많음

feed.title: Agentic AI Adoption in Indian Enterprises: Growing Adoption, Nascent Scale
feed.desc: Agentic AI Adoption in Indian Enterprises: Growing Adoption, Nascent Scale    Nasscom
feed.titleEn: Agentic AI Adoption in Indian Enterprises: Growing Adoption, Nascent Scale
feed.descEn: Key Highlights Agentic AI adoption among Indian enterprises is moving beyond experimentation 95% of the 200 Indian enterprises surveyed, across industry and revenue segments, have implemented agentic AI in some form – at a pilot stage or in production/ at scale – further corroborated by a significant proportion indicating having a dedicated agentic AI spend allocation from their AI budgets. AI spend itself has risen y-o-y and mirrors global AI spend allocation by end-user enterprises.
summaryLinesEn: Agentic AI adoption among Indian enterprises is moving beyond experimentation 95% of the 200 Indian enterprises surveyed, across industry and revenue segments, have implemented agentic AI in some form – at a pilot stage or in production/ at scale – further corroborated by a significant proportion indicating having a dedicated agentic AI spend allocation from their AI budgets.

Cost of AI, trust in partners, and safe and trusted AI solutions are the key factors enterprises indicate will be crucial to scale AI in the next 12-18 months, as 75%+ seek demonstrable ROI from AI and agentic AI investments.
It examines not just adoption, but the depth of deployment, scale, and roadmap for agentic AI.
feed.summary:
Agentic AI adoption among Indian enterprises is moving beyond experimentation 95% of the 200 Indian enterprises surveyed, across industry and revenue segments, have implemented agentic AI in some form – at a pilot stage or in production/ at scale – further corroborated by a significant proportion indicating having a dedicated agentic AI spend allocation from their AI budgets.
Cost of AI, trust in partners, and safe and trusted AI solutions are the key factors enterprises indicate will be crucial to scale AI in the next 12-18 months, as 75%+ seek demonstrable ROI from AI and agentic AI investments.
It examines not just adoption, but the depth of deployment, scale, and roadmap for agentic AI.

localization.title: 인도 기업의 에이전트 AI 채택 · 채택 증가, 초기 규모
summaryLines: 인도 기업의 에이전트 AI 도입은 실험 수준을 넘어 산업 및 수익 부문 전반에 걸쳐 조사 대상인 200개 인도 기업 중 95%가 어떤 형태로든(파일럿 단계 또는 생산/규모) 에이전트 AI를 구현했으며, 이는 AI 예산에서 전용 에이전트 AI 지출 할당이 있음을 나타내는 상당한 비율로 더욱 확증됨
AI 비용, 파트너에 대한 신뢰, 안전하고 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 솔루션은 기업이 향후 12~18개월 내에 AI를 확장하는 데 중요할 것이라고 지적하는 핵심 요소임 · 75% 이상이 AI 및 에이전트 AI 투자에서 입증 가능한 ROI를 추구하기 때문임
채택뿐만 아니라 에이전트 AI의 배포 깊이, 규모 및 로드맵도 검토함

feed.title: Competition Among China’s AI Models Is Intensifying as the Chip Sector Advances
feed.desc: Competition Among China’s AI Models Is Intensifying as the Chip Sector Advances    Goldman Sachs
feed.titleEn: Competition Among China’s AI Models Is Intensifying as the Chip Sector Advances
feed.descEn: Investors are debating how the landscape for AI-model companies will evolve as competition intensifies.
summaryLinesEn: China’s semiconductor sector is ramping up faster than the market expected, though bottlenecks persist.

The competition between makers of China’s artificial intelligence (AI) models is intensifying, raising questions among investors on the sustainability of leadership in model performance, with increasing focus on cost efficiencies and the harness layer.
The event featured companies that form the entire AI supply chain: 400 companies were represented and over 1,400 investors attended the event in Hong Kong.

feed.descEn: Data – Year External OEM External OEM Market Annual Growth % 2025 $35,313 4.3% 2026 $43,365 22.8% 2027 $45,158 4.1%
summaryLinesEn: Worldwide Enterprise External OEM Storage Systems Market Spending showed a 33.7% growth in Q2 2026 and is expected to grow an average of 8.0% over a 5-year period, according to IDC.
The result follows 22.7% growth in the first quarter and compares with 3.9% growth for full-year 2025.

Memory supply can generally be obtained, but demand runs ahead of supply, and enterprise buyers, lacking the multiyear agreements hyperscalers hold, are paying elevated market prices and in some cases pulling purchases forward ahead of further increases.

feed.desc: Becamex IDC approved 200-home sale: what it means for Becamex IDC stock    AD HOC NEWS
feed.titleEn: Becamex IDC approved 200-home sale: what it means for Becamex IDC stock
feed.descEn: For Becamex IDC stock, the deal means VND 1.012 trillion in contracts. MBS forecasts VND 3,970 billion profit for 2026.
summaryLinesEn: Becamex IDC (ISIN VN000000BCM3) had approved the sale of 200 Green City homes for VND 1.012 trillion on September 29, 2026, creating a concrete property transaction for the industrial real estate group.
For Becamex IDC stock, the deal means VND 1.012 trillion in contracts.
The transaction is a related-party deal because Becamex holds 49.76 percent of Becamex IJC, according to the same September 29 report from Tin nhanh chung khoan .

feed.title: CEPAL continúa en Santiago con agenda sobre integración
feed.desc: CEPAL continúa este jueves en Santiago mesas de trabajo sobre integración regional, inteligencia artificial y desarrollo    De Último Minuto
feed.titleEn: CEPAL continúa en Santiago con agenda sobre integración
feed.descEn: La CEPAL continúa en Santiago su 41.º período de sesiones con debates sobre integración regional, inteligencia artificial y desarrollo productivo.
summaryLinesEn: Santiago. — Las actividades del 41.º Período de Sesiones de la CEPAL continúan este jueves en Santiago con una agenda centrada en los principales desafíos y oportunidades que enfrenta América Latina y el Caribe ante la nueva realidad geopolítica, tecnológica y económica.

Recomendamos leer: CEPAL coloca a Santiago y al Cibao en el centro del desarrollo económico de República Dominicana, afirma Andrés Cueto Posteriormente, a las 4:30 de la tarde, será abordada la transformación digital, la inteligencia artificial y el desarrollo productivo, con la participación de funcionarios, especialistas y representantes de organismos internacionales.

A partir de las 2:30 de la tarde, se desarrollará el seminario de alto nivel con la Mesa 1, titulada “Una nueva etapa en la integración regional: qué hacer y cómo avanzar”, con representantes de Barbados, Brasil, México, CARICOM, SICA y el sector empresarial dominicano.

localization.title: ECLAC는 통합에 관한 의제를 가지고 산티아고에서 계속됨
summaryLines: 산티아고 · — ECLAC 제41차 회의 활동은 새로운 지정학적, 기술적, 경제적 현실에 직면하여 라틴 아메리카와 카리브해 지역이 직면한 주요 과제와 기회에 초점을 맞춘 의제를 바탕으로 이번 주 목요일 산티아고에서 계속됨
다음을 읽어 보시기 바람 · ECLAC는 산티아고와 시바오를 도미니카 공화국의 경제 발전의 중심에 두고 있다고 Andrés Cueto는 말함 · 나중에 오후 4시 30분에는 관료, 전문가 및 국제기구 대표가 참여하여 디지털 변혁, 인공 지능 및 생산적 개발에 대해 논의할 것임
오후 2시 30분부터 바베이도스, 브라질, 멕시코, CARICOM, SICA, 도미니카 기업계 대표들이 참석해 '지역 통합의 새로운 단계 · 무엇을 해야 하고 어떻게 전진할 것인가'라는 제목의 고위급 세미나가 표 1에서 진행됨

feed.descEn: In an exclusive interview with South Asian Herald’s Rajesh Mehta, International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Deputy Secretary-General Tomas Lamanauskas discusses India’s growing role in global digital cooperation, the Indian diaspora’s contributions to innovation,…

“Achieving universal meaningful connectivity will require an estimated USD 2.6-2.8 trillion by 2030, including USD 1.5-1.7 trillion for digital infrastructure, with much of the gap concentrated in the Global South.”

“The digital economy depends on largely invisible infrastructure: mobile broadband now covers more than 96% of the global population; more than 19,000 satellites orbit Earth, compared with roughly 1,000 a little over a decade ago, data centers accounted for more than one-fifth of global greenfield investment values in 2025; and, as mentioned earlier, submarine cables carry more than 99% of international data traffic.”

localization.title: ITU의 Tomas Lamanauskas, 포괄적인 AI, 디지털 팬데믹 및 UN에서 인도의 역할에 대해 - South Asian Herald
summaryLines: 민주적 가치, 지역 사회 지도자 표창 메릴랜드, 남아시아계 미국인 건강 서밋 최초 개최 인도 식품 및 농업 수출업체가 시드니와 멜버른에서 호주 구매자를 만나 무역 및 안보 뿌리와 권리에 초점을 맞추기 위한 아니타 아난드(Anita Anand)의 인도, 아랍에미리트 방문 · 인도 가족을 위한 독일의 연구 옵션이 추가됨 다음에 댓글을 작성할 때 내 이름, 이메일, 웹사이트를 이 브라우저에 저장하세요
“보편적이고 의미 있는 연결성을 달성하려면 2030년까지 디지털 인프라에 1조 5~1조 7천억 달러를 포함해 약 2조 6천억~2조 8천억 달러가 필요할 것으로 예상되며, 그 격차는 대부분 남반구에 집중되어 있음”

"디지털 경제는 대체로 눈에 보이지 않는 인프라에 달려 있음 · 모바일 광대역은 현재 전 세계 인구의 96% 이상을 커버하고 있음 · 19,000개 이상의 위성이 지구 궤도를 돌고 있음 · 10여 년 전 약 1,000개에 비해 데이터 센터는 2025년 전 세계 신규 투자 가치의 5분의 1 이상을 차지함 · 앞서 언급했듯이 해저 케이블은 국제 데이터 트래픽의 99% 이상을 전달함"

feed.title: India Voice AI Readiness 2026
feed.desc: India Voice AI Readiness 2026    Nasscom
feed.titleEn: India Voice AI Readiness 2026
feed.descEn: Key Highlights Adoption is moving beyond pilots, but maturity remains uneven Voice AI adoption is progressing from pilots into production, with 31% of organizations reaching limited production, while only 13% have scaled. The most significant difference between early and scaled adopters is not the model used, but the level of enterprise integration.
summaryLinesEn: Adoption is moving beyond pilots, but maturity remains uneven Voice AI adoption is progressing from pilots into production, with 31% of organizations reaching limited production, while only 13% have scaled.

The next two years will focus on building the Voice AI operating stack Investment is expected to shift from pilots towards the foundations required to scale, with two-thirds expecting Voice AI investment to increase by up to 50%.
It examines the shift towards enterprise adoption, with a focus on multilingual performance, capability assessment, business impact, and ROI realization.

feed.title: Cepal advierte que América Latina debe cerrar brechas para impulsar su desarrollo
feed.desc: Cepal advierte que América Latina debe cerrar brechas para impulsar su desarrollo    Noticias Telemicro
feed.titleEn: Cepal advierte que América Latina debe cerrar brechas para impulsar su desarrollo
feed.descEn: Durante el 41.º período de sesiones de la Cepal, que inició este miércoles en Santiago de los Caballeros, el organismo presentó el informe “Gestión de las transformaciones en una era de rupturas”.
summaryLinesEn: Santiago de los Caballeros, República Dominicana. — La Comisión Económica para América Latina y el Caribe (Cepal) advirtió que la región necesita avanzar en una serie de transformaciones para cerrar las brechas estructurales que limitan su desarrollo y dificultan su inserción en una economía mundial marcada por cambios acelerados.

El informe constituye la visión estratégica de la Cepal para América Latina y el Caribe y busca orientar a los gobiernos de la región frente a un escenario internacional caracterizado por transformaciones económicas, tecnológicas y geopolíticas.
La Cepal explicó que estas transformaciones no pueden depender de un solo gobierno, debido a que sus resultados requieren procesos de 10, 20 o hasta 30 años .

localization.title: ECLAC는 라틴 아메리카가 발전을 촉진하기 위해 격차를 줄여야 한다고 경고함
summaryLines: 도미니카공화국 산티아고 데 로스 카바예로스 · — 라틴아메리카 및 카리브해 경제위원회(ECLAC)는 이 지역의 발전을 제한하고 가속화되는 변화로 특징지어지는 세계 경제에의 진입을 방해하는 구조적 격차를 줄이기 위해 이 지역이 일련의 변화를 추진해야 한다고 경고함
이 보고서는 라틴 아메리카와 카리브해 지역에 대한 ECLAC의 전략적 비전을 구성하고 경제, 기술 및 지정학적 변화로 특징지어지는 국제 시나리오에 직면하여 지역 정부를 안내하고자 함
ECLAC는 이러한 변화는 결과에 10년, 20년, 심지어 30년의 과정이 필요하기 때문에 단일 정부에 의존할 수 없다고 설명함

feed.title: A five-step roadmap to closing the AI evaluation gap
feed.desc: A five-step roadmap to closing the AI evaluation gap    OECD AI Policy Observatory
feed.titleEn: A five-step roadmap to closing the AI evaluation gap
feed.descEn: A five-step roadmap for closing the AI evaluation gap to strengthen trust, security, adoption and effective AI governance.
summaryLinesEn: Following the establishment in 2023 of AI Safety Institutes by the UK and the US[SR1] [SR2] (both renamed in 2025), a total of 11 jurisdictions, including the EU, India and Singapore, have now followed a similar model and established AI safety institutes or similar organisations that conduct testing and evaluation of foundation models.
This includes the efforts of safety institutes and standards organisations, such as the “ Zero Draft ” project launched by NIST to expedite the standards process.

The private sector is also expanding evaluation initiatives After discovering that Mythos could detect severe vulnerabilities in all major web browsers and operating systems, Anthropic launched Project Glasswing to make the unreleased frontier model available to several organisations to help secure their systems.
feed.summary:
Following the establishment in 2023 of AI Safety Institutes by the UK and the US[SR1] [SR2] (both renamed in 2025), a total of 11 jurisdictions, including the EU, India and Singapore, have now followed a similar model and established AI safety institutes or similar organisations that conduct testing and evaluation of foundation models.
This includes the efforts of safety institutes and standards organisations, such as the “ Zero Draft ” project launched by NIST to expedite the standards process.
The private sector is also expanding evaluation initiatives After discovering that Mythos could detect severe vulnerabilities in all major web browsers and operating systems, Anthropic launched Project Glasswing to make the unreleased frontier model available to several organisations to help secure their systems.

This includes the efforts of safety institutes and standards organisations, such as the “ Zero Draft ” project launched by NIST to expedite the standards process.

The private sector is also expanding evaluation initiatives After discovering that Mythos could detect severe vulnerabilities in all major web browsers and operating systems, Anthropic launched Project Glasswing to make the unreleased frontier model available to several organisations to help secure their systems.

feed.descEn: Canalys Forums this morning recorded a first in its 19-year history as two of its top analysts clashed over whether
summaryLinesEn: The AI-related services sector will produce the fastest growth of all, swelling at a CAGR of 32.5% to hit $347bn by 2031, McBain added.

“We’ve seen the balance of power shifting over the last 12 months from the channel ecosystem to the vendor world, and vendors have been putting more stringent terms [when it comes to] pricing and quotation,” Edwards said.

feed.desc: Citi sees Meta’s Muse AI generating $27 billion in annual revenue by 2030    The American Bazaar
feed.titleEn: Citi sees Meta’s Muse AI generating $27 billion in annual revenue by 2030
feed.descEn: Citigroup estimates Meta’s Muse AI assistant could generate more than $27 billion in annual revenue by 2030 as adoption and engagement grow.
summaryLinesEn: The company said Muse could generate more than $27 billion in annual revenue by 2030, including about $23 billion from transaction-related revenue and roughly $4.5 billion from subscriptions.

READ: Meta’s Muse AI agent adds $192 billion to market value (September 22, 2026) Meta launched Muse as a personal AI agent that can carry out tasks on behalf of users, including sending emails, booking travel, filling out forms and making purchases.
Users can give Muse a task, and the agent can develop a plan, coordinate the resources it needs and adjust its actions when circumstances change.

feed.title: UBS only European bank in AI adoption top 10 led by JPMorgan Chase
feed.desc: UBS only European bank in AI adoption top 10 led by JPMorgan Chase    Euronews.com

sourceContent.headline: UBS only European bank in AI adoption top 10 led by JPMorgan Chase
sourceContent.description: UBS is now the only European lender among the top 10 banks judged most advanced in adopting artificial intelligence, after HSBC dropped out of the top tier of the Evident AI Index, while JPMorgan Chase widened its lead and North American banks tightened their grip.
paragraphs: Roles are changing, and some are not being backfilled, but the banks at the top of our Index are growing, and growing headcount," Mousavizadeh stated.Twelve banks now report a realised or projected return on AI, up from eight, including newcomer Lloyds, which said in January that generative AI delivered around £50 million (€58.8mn) in value in 2025 and should add more than £100 million (€117.6mn) this year."

Royal Bank of Canada was third and Australia's CommBank fourth, with six US and two Canadian banks in the top ten.Evident found that the banks' AI capabilities improved almost three times as fast over the past year as in the three preceding years on average, the quickest progress since it began measuring in 2023."
Evident plans to add a fifth pillar to the index in 2027, measuring the outcomes banks actually achieve from AI.

feed.descEn: UBS is now the only European lender among the top 10 banks judged most advanced in adopting artificial intelligence, after HSBC dropped out of the top tier of the Evident AI Index, while JPMorgan Chase widened its lead and North American banks tightened their grip.
summaryLinesEn: Roles are changing, and some are not being backfilled, but the banks at the top of our Index are growing, and growing headcount," Mousavizadeh stated.Twelve banks now report a realised or projected return on AI, up from eight, including newcomer Lloyds, which said in January that generative AI delivered around £50 million (€58.8mn) in value in 2025 and should add more than £100 million (€117.6mn) this year."

sourceContent.headline: BorgWarner jumps as Morgan Stanley upgrades stock on AI power potential
sourceContent.description: Investing.com -- BorgWarner Inc (NYSE:BWA) shares surged nearly 5% in Tuesday trading after Morgan Stanley raised its rating on the automotive supplier, citing a growing opportunity to capitalize on the artificial intelligence infrastructure boom through off-grid power generation. The Wall Street firm upgraded the stock to Overweight from Equalweight and boosted its price target to $95 from $71, signaling increased confidence in the company's ability to expand beyond its core transportation mark
paragraphs: The Wall Street firm upgraded the stock to Overweight from Equalweight and boosted its price target to $95 from $71, signaling increased confidence in the company's ability to expand beyond its core transportation market.

Analysts expect TurboCell commercial deliveries to begin in 2027, projecting annual deployments could approach 3 gigawatts by 2030, representing roughly 3% of the addressable distributed-power market.
The investment firm estimates that distributed-power operations could generate approximately $1.2 billion in EBITDA by 2030, accounting for roughly 35% of the group's total earnings.

sourceContent.headline: [News] Qualcomm, Apple, MediaTek Battle It Out on TSMC 2nm: Inside Their Flagship AI Strategies
sourceContent.description: The flagship mobile chip race is entering the 2nm era, with on-device AI emerging as a key battleground. According to ijiwei, Qualcomm, Apple, and Med...
paragraphs: According to Economic Daily News , Apple, NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, and MediaTek have reportedly increased their reservations for TSMC’s 2nm family by 10% to 20%, prompting the foundry to accelerate its capacity expansion.
According to ijiwei , Qualcomm, Apple, and MediaTek all unveiled TSMC-made 2nm processors in September 2026, marking the industry’s shift to GAA nanosheet transistors.

According to MediaTek , its second-generation high-efficiency NPU cuts power consumption by 40% for always-on AI, while the higher-performance NPU 1090 delivers 51% faster LLM prefill performance and 55% more token generation per watt.

feed.desc: 【解説】総務省がe-StatのAI対応改修に7億円を概算要求、MCP実装と報道    innovaTopia
feed.titleEn: 【解説】総務省がe-StatのAI対応改修に7億円を概算要求、MCP実装と報道
feed.descEn: 総務省は2027年度予算の概算要求で、政府統計の窓口e-StatのAI対応改修に7.0億円を求めた。10月5日の読売新聞はMCPでの実装と開発費1.6億円を報じたが、概算要求の資料に方式名はない。民間のMCPサーバやデジタル庁の先行例と並べ、国の統計の窓口がAIを迎える意味を読み解く。
summaryLinesEn: 資料が掲げる目的は、統計データの利活用や高度な利用へのニーズが一段と高まっていることへの対応です。
そのための手段として、AIが統計データを円滑に取得できるようにするデータ提供の見直しと、最新技術を使った検索性の強化が挙げられています。
主な経費として、政府統計共同利用システム整備経費5.5億円（新規）と、統計基盤デジタル化推進等経費1.6億円を挙げる。

そのための手段として、AIが統計データを円滑に取得できるようにするデータ提供の見直しと、最新技術を使った検索性の強化が挙げられています。

主な経費として、政府統計共同利用システム整備経費5.5億円（新規）と、統計基盤デジタル化推進等経費1.6億円を挙げる。

feed.titleEn: AI Server Demand Sustains Memory Contract Price Increases in 4Q26, While Consumer-Side Pressure Persists, Says TrendForce
feed.descEn: TrendForce’s latest memory industry research reveals that DRAM suppliers continue to prioritize advanced-process capacity for high-performance server products in 4Q26, keeping the overall market undersupplied. However, the pace of contract price increases is expected to moderate, with conventional DRAM prices projected to rise 10–15% QoQ.
summaryLinesEn: However, the pace of contract price increases is expected to moderate, with conventional DRAM prices projected to rise 10–15% QoQ.
Meanwhile, the NAND Flash market is seeing a divergence between accelerating AI demand and weak consumer demand, although prices are still rising across segments.

summaryLines: 다만 고정가격 상승폭은 둔화될 전망임 · 기존 DRAM 가격은 전분기 대비 10~15% 상승할 것으로 예상됨
한편, NAND 플래시 시장은 부문별로 가격이 여전히 상승하고 있음에도 불구하고 AI 수요 가속화와 소비자 수요 약화 사이에서 괴리를 보이고 있음

2026년 4분기 기존 DRAM 고정 가격은 QoQ 10~15% 증가할 것으로 예상되고, NAND 플래시 고정 가격은 15~20% 증가할 것으로 예상됨 · Enterprise SSD는 CSP의 강한 수요로 인해 가격 상승이 가속화될 것으로 예상되는 유일한 범주임 · TrendForce의 최신 메모리 업계 조사에 따르면 DRAM 공급업체는 26년 4분기에도 계속해서 고성능 서버 제품에 대한 고급 프로세스 용량을 우선시하여 전체 시장 공급 부족을 유지하고 있는 것으로 나타남

feed.title: Governing with agentic AI: when machines act on government’s behalf
feed.desc: Governing with agentic AI: when machines act on government’s behalf    OECD AI Policy Observatory
feed.titleEn: Governing with agentic AI: when machines act on government’s behalf
feed.descEn: Agentic AI raises new questions about how governments can maintain standards of safe, secure and trustworthy AI while machines act on their behalf.
summaryLinesEn: It works through four dimensions, (1) assessing risks and limiting what an agent may do up front; (2) keeping humans meaningfully accountable; (3) putting technical controls in place; and (4) enabling end-user responsibility.

To help answer these questions, a new Working Group on Agentic AI in Government, has been established at the OECD under the Working Party of Senior Digital Government Officials (E-Leaders) with a goal to seek to understand what governing with agentic AI should look like in practice, building on the OECD’s existing work on the agentic AI landscape .
Nearly all OECD governments have adopted AI to help meet these expectations, and the OECD’s 2025 Governing with AI report set out the current state of play across core government functions.

localization.title: 에이전트 AI를 사용한 통치 · 기계가 정부를 대신하여 행동하는 경우
summaryLines: 이는 4가지 차원을 통해 작동함 · (1) 위험을 평가하고 상담원이 사전에 수행할 수 있는 작업을 제한함 · (2) 인간에게 의미 있는 책임을 부여하는 것; (3) 기술적 통제를 마련함 · (4) 최종 사용자의 책임을 활성화함
이러한 질문에 대한 답변을 돕기 위해, 에이전트 AI 환경에 대한 OECD의 기존 작업을 기반으로 에이전트 AI를 사용한 통치가 실제로 어떤 모습이어야 하는지 이해하고자 하는 목표로 OECD의 고위 디지털 정부 공무원 작업반(E-Leaders) 산하의 에이전트 AI에 대한 새로운 실무 그룹이 OECD에 설립됨
거의 모든 OECD 정부는 이러한 기대를 충족하기 위해 AI를 채택했으며, OECD의 2025년 AI 거버넌스 보고서는 핵심 정부 기능 전반에 걸친 현재 활동 상태를 설명함

feed.desc: Goldman Sachs just gave AI stock fans a cold, hard reality check    Yahoo Finance

sourceContent.headline: Goldman Sachs just gave AI stock fans a cold, hard reality check
sourceContent.description: Goldman Sachs strategist Ryan Hammond thinks hyperscalers like Amazon, Oracle, and Microsoft need to generate about $300 billion in AI revenue in the "next few years" to break even on their investments.
paragraphs: Announced backlogs for the group exceed $1.5 trillion.
Hyperscaler cloud revenues have accelerated sharply this year, annualizing at about $70 billion above the pre-AI trend in the second quarter of 2026.

Goldman Sachs strategist Ryan Hammond crunched some numbers and thinks hyperscalers like Amazon ( AMZN ), Oracle ( ORCL ), and Microsoft ( MSFT ) need to generate about $300 billion in AI revenue in the "next few years" to break even on their investments.

feed.title: BofA unpacks the threat Meta's Muse poses to banks
feed.desc: 'A multiyear evolutionary risk': BofA unpacks the threat Meta's Muse poses to banks    Business Insider
feed.titleEn: BofA unpacks the threat Meta's Muse poses to banks
feed.descEn: Banks make a lot of money from people leaving cash idle in low-yielding accounts, but those days could be coming to an end thanks to agentic AI.
summaryLinesEn: According to a study from Bankrate, $10,000 earning 4% per year would earn $2,167 over a five-year period, while one would earn just $5 over that time at a 0.01% interest rate.

In a client note on Wednesday, BofA said agentic AI assistants like Meta's Muse — which can perform tasks autonomously, including making purchases and dealing with account admin— pose a "multiyear evolutionary risk" to banks' business models.
This way, BofA said, the banks can at least keep the money in-house with their own investment products.

feed.desc: Value investing in AI narrative-driven markets    UBS
feed.titleEn: Value investing in AI narrative-driven markets
feed.descEn: Steve Magill explores where AI may create durable value, and where the narrative may be moving faster than fundamentals.
summaryLinesEn: 1 Big Tech to Spend USD 650 Billion This Year as AI Race Intensifies, Bloomberg, Feb 6, 2026 and Charted: The USD 448B AI Spending Surge by Big Tech, Visual Capitalist, Apr 20, 2026.

2 While AI adoption curves will vary by industry, we expect this technology to become universally embedded in digital workflows, in much the same way the internet moved from a standalone product to invisible infrastructure within two decades.

Applications range from accelerating revenue growth and improving pricing to personalizing offerings, optimizing supply chains and structurally reducing costs – in each case, AI functions as a margin and productivity lever rather than a product in itself.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley says AI agents could boost, not threaten, call-center firms
feed.desc: Morgan Stanley says AI agents could boost, not threaten, call-center firms    Yahoo Finance
feed.titleEn: Morgan Stanley says AI agents could boost, not threaten, call-center firms
feed.descEn: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley said in a note Wednesday that the rise of consumer AI agents such as Meta’s Muse could benefit communications and software vendors long seen as vulnerable to automation, rather than threaten them.
summaryLinesEn: This AI enabler is up 90%+ since picked by our AI models in July -- and still has a 62% upside » Suddenly, These ‘AI-Proof Stocks’ Are Anything But Barrons.com • 19d ago META NFLX Meta’s AI Agent for Consumers Has Arrived.

Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley said in a note Wednesday that the rise of consumer AI agents such as Meta's Muse could benefit communications and software vendors long seen as vulnerable to automation, rather than threaten them.

"Consumer agents lower the effort required to engage a business, while enterprise AI lowers the cost of responding, potentially expanding communications volumes and usage-based monetization," she wrote.

feed.titleEn: Learnings from Earnings
feed.descEn: Global strength defined the 2Q 2026 earnings season as earnings growth broadened, execution drove dispersion, and AI investment gained traction.
summaryLinesEn: Adjusted S&P 500 earnings growth reached 32% year-over-year, supported by continued strength in AI infrastructure spending.

Across major indices, returns were largely driven by earnings growth as many of these markets experienced valuation contractions over the quarter.

feed.title: Smartphone Shipments Set for Record 16.7% Drop in 2026, as the Memory Crisis Hits Full Force
feed.desc: Smartphone Shipments Set for Record 16.7% Drop in 2026, as the Memory Crisis Hits Full Force    IDC | Trusted Tech Intelligence

sourceContent.headline: Smartphone Shipments Set for Record 16.7% Drop in 2026, as the Memory Crisis Hits Full Force
sourceContent.description: IDC forecasts a record 16.7% smartphone shipment decline in 2026 as the memory crisis pushes ASPs up 27.6% to $581. See who wins and who doesn't.
paragraphs: According to IDC’s Worldwide Quarterly Mobile Phone Tracker , worldwide smartphone shipments will fall 16.7% in 2026 to just over 1 billion units.
Total market value will still grow 6.3% to $613 billion, because higher prices are now doing the heavy lifting that volume once did.
The memory shortage , which started in late 2025, is striking hard in the second half of 2026, with shipments forecast to drop by 27.2% YoY.

sourceContent.headline: Rakuten Mobile, Partners Secure ITU-T Standard for Low-Latency AI Networks
sourceContent.description: Rakuten Mobile, Partners Secure ITU-T Standard for Low-Latency AI Networks
paragraphs: He has over 15 years of experience in mobile broadband technologies and solutions, conducting research and analysis on various technology segments and producing articles and write-ups on the latest developments within the sector.

Rakuten Mobile, along with six other leading Japanese telecommunications and technology companies, announced that the framework of low-latency and energy-efficient networks to support the AI era has been approved as an international standard by the International Telecommunication Union Telecommunication Standardization Sector (ITU-T) on August 13, 2026.

Within ITU-T, they are also contributing to the development of a Recommendation on functional architecture for low-latency and energy-efficient networks, targeted for October 2028, and will continue contributing to the global adoption of APN to support the AI era.

feed.desc: [News] Xiaomi Unveils 3nm XRING O3, Reportedly First Mobile Chip to Support LPDDR6; Debuts on Xiaomi 18 Fold    TrendForce

sourceContent.headline: [News] Xiaomi Unveils 3nm XRING O3, Reportedly First Mobile Chip to Support LPDDR6; Debuts on Xiaomi 18 Fold
sourceContent.description: Xiaomi has unveiled the long-awaited XRINGO3 on August 24. According to EE Times China and IT Home, the 3nm chip is the world’s first mobile processor...
paragraphs: Xiaomi, according to IT Home, says the XRING O3 packs 24 billion transistors, 26% more than its predecessor, while its die size comes in at 133mm².
Xiaomi also introduced the XRING D100, which IT Home describes as China’s first 3nm high-compute AI chip for intelligent driving.

According to EE Times China and IT Home , the 3nm chip is the world’s first mobile processor to support LPDDR6, delivering speeds of up to 10,667Mbps and memory bandwidth of 113.8GB/s, a 48% increase over the XRING O1.

sourceContent.description: JPMorgan flagged bearish technical signals flashing in the US market as investors head into what's historically been the weakest period of the year.
paragraphs: Dating back to 1928, the S&P 500 saw an average loss of 0.02% during that period, with the average correction in down years being 7.35%, according to an analysis from Bank of America.

The S&P 500 rallied to a fresh all-time high of 7,816 recently, but has remained well below that range, Hunter said, though he noted that the index remained above its "support zone" of 7,521 to 7,620.

First is the dichotomy between the AI hardware names and the hyperscalers, and the similarities in the market trends that led to the March 2000 peak in the communications equipment capital investment cycle trade theme," Hunter said.

feed.title: Goldman Sachs partner warns of 'huge danger' in letting AI replace bankers' reasoning skills
feed.desc: Goldman Sachs partner warns of 'huge danger' in letting AI replace bankers' reasoning skills    CNBC

sourceContent.headline: Goldman Sachs partner warns of 'huge danger' in letting AI replace bankers' reasoning skills
sourceContent.description: Goldman Sachs is embracing AI, but one of its senior tech leaders warns that it comes with an unintended risk: weakening the reasoning skills of future bankers.
paragraphs: A Goldman Sachs partner leading one of the bank's flagship artificial intelligence projects warned that AI's spread across Wall Street risks hobbling the thinking capabilities of the next generation of financiers.

Even Goldman, one of the world's top investment banks, hasn't yet "figured out" how it will manage the transition the company has begun, said Churchman, who is also co-chair of the firm's Global Banking and Markets AI working group.
Just as people lost navigation and memorization skills with modern inventions, bankers risk losing analytical abilities if algorithms handle all the heavy lifting, Churchman said.

sourceContent.headline: [News] Unitree Sees Embodied AI ‘ChatGPT Moment’ in 2–3 Years at Earliest, Flags AI Model Limitations
sourceContent.description: Just a day after its STAR Market listing, Unitree Robotics is striking a cautious note on the next major breakthrough in humanoid robotics. According ...
paragraphs: China’s Humanoid Robot Market to Reach CNY 15 Billion in 2026 as Commercial Validation Begins, Says TrendForce [News] China’s Robot Maker Unitree Heads for IPO at RMB 60.99B Valuation, Backed by DeepSeek and Tencent

Wang said Unitree has worked with multiple automakers on production-line applications since 2024 and tested robots in its own factories, but their efficiency still trails human workers and new tasks often require retraining.

According to EE Times China , Chairman Wang Xingxing said at World Robot Conference that the industry’s long-awaited “ChatGPT moment” for embodied AI could come in two to three years at the earliest, or take five to ten years.

sourceContent.headline: AI-Powered Banking: The Intelligence Revolution Reshaping BFSI — And the Talent Race Behind It
sourceContent.description: Picture a Monday morning at a mid-sized private bank. A loan officer logs in and reviews five credit applications — but before she reads a single line, an AI model has already scored each borrower using 400+ data signals, flagged two anomalies in transaction history, and cross-referenced all five against AML watchlists. Down the hall, the fraud team hasn't been alerted once today — not because fraud stopped, but because the system intercepted suspicious transactions overnight and blocked them before a single rupee moved.
paragraphs: An important aspect is that AI adoption in BFSI is no longer purely a technology or talent discussion.
Hiring the right talent is essential, but embedding AI into the operating model is where the real transformation begins.
The institutions that will realize the greatest value are those that redesign processes, strengthen governance, and build trust in AI-assisted decision-making.

sourceContent.headline: KISDI "AI 노출도 높은 산업일수록 임금 불평등 확대"
sourceContent.description: 인공지능 노출도가 높은 산업일수록 임금 분포의 양극단을 중심으로 산업 내 임금 불평등이 확대되는 경향이 나타난다는 분석이 나왔다.아울러 산업별 저임금 일자리 위험도와 임금 분포 변화를 지속적으로 파악할 수 있는 분석 체계를 구축할 필요가 있다고 제안했다…
paragraphs: 19일 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)이 발간한 'AI 노출과 임금 불평등: 산업 수준의 실증분석' 보고서에 따르면 모든 통제변수를 포함한 분석에서 AI 노출도가 0.1p 높은 산업은 상위 10%와 하위 10% 근로자 간 임금 격차를 나타내는 P90/P10 배율의 증가율이 8.13%p 높게 나타났다.
장민권 정보미디어부 [email protected] 네이버웹툰 연재작 '오늘의 우리만화' 최종 수상작 싹쓸이 2026-10-22 18:09 외부 제공 개인정보 줄여 유출 차단...
이는 국가데이터처 지역별 고용조사를 활용해 임금 분포 산출이 가능한 217개 산업 소분류를 대상으로 AI 확산 이전인 2013년과 2023년 사이의 변화를 분석한 결과다.

sourceContent.headline: Singapore ranked first in Counterpoint Research’s 2025 Global AI Cities Index, ahead of Seoul, Beijing and San Francisco — remarkable for a country less than half the size of Greater London that is home to operations from 80 of the world’s top 100 technology firms.
sourceContent.description: Singapore topped a 100-city AI adoption index by combining government programmes, corporate density, talent and infrastructure inside an area under half Greater London’s size.
paragraphs: At the end of 2025, the entire country covered 744.3 square kilometres, a little over 47 percent of Greater London’s area.
Singapore built machinery for turning strategy into projects Singapore launched its first national AI strategy in 2019 and National AI Strategy 2.0 in December 2023 .
It does not mean 80 of those companies were founded in Singapore, moved their principal headquarters there or operate a large AI research laboratory in the country.

feed.desc: KISDI, AI 고노출 산업서 저임금 고용 둔화·임금 불평등 확대 경향    중부매일

sourceContent.headline: KISDI, AI 고노출 산업서 저임금 고용 둔화·임금 불평등 확대 경향
paragraphs: AI 노출도가 0.1포인트 높을수록 상위 10%와 하위 10% 임금 격차(P90/P10)의 증가율이 8.13%p 높았다.
19일 연구원에 따르면 보고서는 국가데이터처 지역별 고용 조사를 활용해 217개 산업 소분류를 대상으로 2013~2023년 변화를 분석했다.
［중부매일 김정기 기자］ 충북혁신도시(진천군 덕산읍)에 있는 정보통신정책연구원(KISDI)이 발간한 ‘프리미엄 리포트 26-7’에서 AI 노출이 임금 불평등에 미치는 영향을 산업 수준에서 실증 분석했다.

feed.title: Goldman studied where AI is squeezing labor markets. Here's what it found
feed.desc: Goldman studied where AI is squeezing labor markets. Here's what it found    CNBC

sourceContent.headline: Goldman studied where AI is squeezing labor markets. Here's what it found
sourceContent.description: Goldman Sachs found that AI is starting to weigh on employment across developed economies.
paragraphs: Goldman combined 11 surveys measuring AI adoption across countries and found that major developed markets have adoption rates of roughly 15% to 20%.
The labor market impact comes as AI adoption is spreading across developed economies.
Employment in the industry is now below trend in the U.S., 39% lower, Canada, down 33%, and Germany 27% below trend, according to the report.
sourceContent.text:
Goldman combined 11 surveys measuring AI adoption across countries and found that major developed markets have adoption rates of roughly 15% to 20%.
